name: Oracle — Action (do)
description:
When to use: The verb or what is happening. Often combined with Adjective and Subject into one prompt.

How to read it: Pick any synonym from the list that fits, blend them, or reinterpret for your setting. Re-roll or ignore if nothing sparks.
